description:
Defects in `crates/gf2-algebra`, found while sweeping comments: `permanent/bipedal3_multiword.rs` documents a panic at $n = 0$ that no assertion produces (the failure is an index out of bounds), and its `no_run` example at $n = 65$ cannot execute; `test_permanent_bipedal3_dispatch_routes_n64_to_multiword` checks only a constant, and the non-SIMD `simd_vs_scalar_cross_check` stub compares the scalar path with itself; the `permanent_bipedal5` panic message directs callers with $n > 63$ to `permanent_ryser`, which has the same bound; the `slow` arm of `cross_check_n!` in `bipedal7.rs` is unused; `benches/s1_n36_speedup.rs` and three examples embed hardware fingerprints, a Rayon version and measured figures, against `@/inv/runtime-observed-provenance`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each documented panic of the permanent entry points is produced by an explicit check, covered by a test, and each panic message names an entry point that accepts the rejected input or none.
- [hard] REQ-02: The named tests assert the dispatch and the SIMD-versus-scalar agreement they are named for, or are removed; unused macro arms are removed.
- [hard] REQ-03: Rustdoc examples in the module execute as doctests or are removed.
- [hard] REQ-04: The bench and examples emit only runtime-observed host facts and their own protocol constants.
title: Permanent module contract, test and provenance defects
